# `documents-unrelated`

The two documents look like different APIs

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `documents-unrelated` |
| **Status** | Planned (M6) |
| **Group** | Spec and engine notices ([RULES.md section 11](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

The two documents share almost nothing, so they look like different APIs rather than two versions of one. The check runs before the diff and compares three signals: operations (method plus path, with version-like segments, server base paths and parameter names normalised), `operationId`s and component schema names. Each is measured as shared items divided by the size of the smaller document, so an API that grew a lot still counts as related. It fires only when every usable signal is below `min-overlap` and the `info.title` or every server host also differs. When it fires, the diff stops and this is the only finding.

## Why this default

Comparing two unrelated APIs reports every operation as removed and added: hundreds of errors that hide the real mistake, usually a wrong path on the command line.

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

Options for this rule:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `min-overlap` | `0.1` | The documents count as related if any signal reaches this share (shared items divided by the size of the smaller document). |
| `signals` | `[operations, operation-ids, schemas]` | Which overlaps to measure. One signal at or above `min-overlap` is enough. A signal that is empty on either side is skipped. |
| `min-size` | `5` | Skip the check when the smaller document has fewer operations and fewer schemas than this, since a tiny overlap means little there. An empty base is always skipped. |
| `ignore-path-segments` | `['^v\d+([a-z]+\d*)?$', '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$']` | Regular expressions for path segments dropped before comparing paths, anywhere in the path (by default `v1`, `v2beta1`, `2024-01-01`). Works with any number of different prefixes. |
| `strip-prefixes` | `[]` | Extra path prefixes removed before comparing, e.g. `[/api, /internal]`. |
| `when` | `manual` | `manual` skips the check when both inputs are the same path at two git revisions. `always` checks those too. |

```yaml
rules:
  documents-unrelated: error
```

## How to fix

Check that both inputs point at the same API. For an intentional rewrite, set `documents-unrelated: off` in the policy, or lower `min-overlap`.
